coreFirstGate.rule: Core assemblies are used for every editorial section; custom blocks are limited to reusable object cards and the semantic newsletter form.

sections.reason: Brand, tagline, and nav links can be edited with core text/button blocks.
Asymmetric editorial layout and decorative flatlay can be represented by core layout blocks plus CSS classes.
Section shell/filter controls are core. Object cards are custom because they are reusable typed objet embeds.
Narrative band is static editable prose and layout.
Storefront visual and shop metadata can be core wrappers/text with classes.
Magazine teaser row is editable static content.
Copy/layout are core; real semantic signup form needs a custom static block.
Footer copy and link are ordinary editable core content.

customBlocks.name: wbdc/maison-object-card
customBlocks.reason: Reusable typed objet card for shop grids and journal embeds.
customBlocks.coreRejection: Core groups can draw one static card but do not provide a coherent reusable metadata/story reveal editing model.
customBlocks.editorModel: RichText on visible title/category/price/story/button; variant settings as attributes.
customBlocks.editorParity: edit and save share article/details child order.
customBlocks.saveContract: article.object-card with photo, metadata, heading, details story

customBlocks.name: wbdc/maison-newsletter-form
customBlocks.reason: Semantic newsletter form with labels and typed inputs.
customBlocks.coreRejection: Core search is semantically wrong and core buttons/paragraphs cannot save form controls.
customBlocks.editorModel: Labels and button text inline editable; input settings as attributes.
customBlocks.editorParity: edit disables the same form controls without changing geometry.
customBlocks.saveContract: form with label/input pairs and submit button
